contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-payment-methods-dynamic-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-dynamic-payment-methods-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-dynamic-payment-methods.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/dynamic-payment-methods`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/dynamic-payment-methods, Stripe dynamically displays and orders the eligible methods for the customer while the merchant manages most methods in Dashboard. Checkout and advanced Payment Element migrate by removing payment_method_types, with the pre-2023-08-16 advanced integration replacing it with enabled automatic_payment_methods (new raw lines 7-60; old raw lines 6-58). Direct charges or on_behalf_of use connected-account settings. Stripe filters using applicable account, product, currency, final amount, API and customer-country constraints plus optional configurations, rules and tests, and orders eligible methods using more than 100 signals plus network data. The per-transaction PaymentIntent exclusion example leaves wallet settings to the integration-specific wallets hash (new raw lines 75-153; old raw lines 73-156). source-stripe-dynamic-payment-methods.md captures the core controls, while the wallet error and legacy migration need their documented integration scope. The guide covers checkout display eligibility and order, with no successful payment transition established.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/dynamic-payment-methods, November 7 reroutes the Connect link, fixes the May 8 cURL argument continuation without changing the documented API setting, and replaces the Node exclusion example with an equivalent cURL request (old raw lines 19-58 and old raw lines 87-108; new raw lines 20-60 and new raw lines 89-105). The wording and table edits are presentational, and the raw shows no change in eligibility policy. Preserve the dates and the reciprocal concept and support matrix routes in source-stripe-dynamic-payment-methods.md. Record the old and new TWINT future-use and Bacs Mobile Payment Element examples as conflicting with the November method or support matrix documentation. Keep Swish's Checkout subscription exclusion distinct from the matrix's send_invoice-only entry and the overview's product labels. Preserve pre-2023-08-16 advanced migration, wallet settings scoped to the PaymentIntent case, and the final amount, customer country, rules and experiments used in eligibility or display (old raw lines 110-156; new raw lines 107-153).
